name: Katei Kyoushi x Saimin 2 ~Zettai Juujun, Takabisha Shimai o Dosukebe Inran ni Saimin Sousa~
original_name: 家庭教師X催眠2 ～絶対従順、高飛車姉妹をドスケベ淫乱に催眠操作～
source:
The main character, Masato's tutor was evil childhood friends! His mother asked for them to tutor him because of his poor grades. These sisters have been abusing him for a very long time.

During the tutoring sessions, the Shinjo sisters use him as an outlet for their stress, which weakens him both mentally and physically.  Then one day, he meets Ootomo, the owner of a secret club called “Gentil Donna”. 

The hypnosis device he borrows from Ootomo will soon involve not only the heroines, but also all the other people involved in the club.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/ks2/about.html]Official website[/url]]
